Unusually Sensitive Area (USA) means a drinking water or ecological resource area that is unusually sensitive to environmental damage from a hazardous liquid pipeline release, as identified under § 195.6 . Welder means a person who performs manual or semi-automatic welding. Welding operator means a person who operates machine or automatic welding equipment.
